lens: infrastructure rubric + public app release gate + CANON-011/019/041/047/048/051
primaryListVerdict: All seven live-premise items shipped; three second-order innovations were generated and implemented, with release truth verified in a real staging browser.

items.title: Render the next session's context, not the closing session's exhaustion
items.why: Latest main is red because closeout embeds its own high token burn into STARTUP_BRIEF, then CI correctly rejects the brief against a fresh process.
items.premise: GitHub run 29545331586 fails check-startup-meter-freshness. context-meter already exposes freshSessionBootstrap, but render-startup-brief ignores it.
liveEvidence: E2E Test Suite run 29545331586 failed at build:check step 25
items.outcome: info-finding: every new agent sees an honest startup projection while genuinely oversized bootstrap context still warns.
items.recipe: Extract a pure startup projection policy, render from freshSessionBootstrap, and add fail-closed paired tests.

L3.recipe: Prove the remote-CI shape without suppressing real pressure.

executionLog: Shipped pure startup-meter projection from freshSessionBootstrap.
Self-test covers exhausted writer, oversized bootstrap, and percent math.
Live startup freshness gate passes.

items.title: Make release readiness require reachable, fully equivalent staging
items.why: The configured staging origin returns 404 while the structural checker exits zero and the brief presents staging as green.
items.premise: A live browser and deploy probe confirm the vhost exists but / returns 404. --check accepts any enumerated status and classifyStatus omits headerParity.
liveEvidence: classifyStatus uses status + shell parity only
items.outcome: conversion: production pushes are preceded by a real staged build matching status, shell, and security headers.
items.recipe: Add a release-only --require-green gate, include header parity, deploy the verified build to Hetzner, and prove green before push.
executionLog: Shipped strict candidate release evaluation, live reachability, shell, security baseline, and freshness checks.
Repaired Hetzner permissions and hardened deploy normalization with rollback.
Generated 157 route-scoped browser-exact CSP policies; Caddy validated and reloaded.
Real staging browser replay is console-clean; candidate-green with production parity honestly yellow.

items.title: Keep the mobile drawer's only close control above its backdrop
items.why: The drawer scrolls, but its hamburger-X cannot be clicked because the root z:199 backdrop covers the header z:100 stacking context.
items.premise: At 390x844 the real-browser click timed out with #nav-backdrop.visible intercepting pointer events.
liveEvidence: Playwright click timeout named the backdrop interceptor
site header z-index 100; portaled drawer z-index 200
items.outcome: conversion: every mobile visitor can close navigation by tap, Escape, or backdrop without losing scroll position.
items.recipe: Raise the header only while open, add a stacking contract, rebuild shell hashes, and replay the flow in-browser.

L3.recipe: Verify tap, Escape, backdrop, scroll lock, restoration.

executionLog: Raised header only while mobile drawer is open; added z-order contract.
Real 390x844 replay proved header 201 > drawer 200 > backdrop 199.
Same hamburger closed drawer; aria, backdrop, and scroll lock restored.

items.title: Unify build-chain and publisher hard-failure resilience under one gate
items.why: Two strong specialized audits have no umbrella verdict, leaving adjacent unattended failure classes able to fall between them.
items.premise: The task board asks to extract the shared audit library first; both specialized checkers are active build checks.
items.outcome: info-finding: one verdict covers optional local state and transient publisher network failures.
items.recipe: Extract common reporting primitives, add a combined CLI/self-test, and broadcast the pattern through Ark.
executionLog: Extracted pure resilience aggregation primitive and combined CLI.
Core aggregation and both specialized child suites pass.
Ark pattern-share shipped as 01JTMTLS3R954A7DABAA920CC7.

items.title: Turn homepage public signals into one coalesced request spine
items.why: One production load emits repeated public-intelligence and founder-presence requests plus three eager prefetch 503s.
items.premise: Homepage has VSPublicIntel but bundled consumers bypass it; document prefetches immediately fail under live edge conditions.
items.outcome: conversion: stable interactive state with fewer requests, no self-inflicted prefetch errors, and identical widget truth.
items.recipe: Generalize the shared cache, preserve compatibility, migrate homepage consumers, remove eager navigation prefetches, add dedupe coverage.
executionLog: Shipped per-URL memory/in-flight/localStorage truth bus and source-driven contract.
Added scoped same-origin GET compatibility membrane for legacy consumers.
Fresh staging browser recorded exactly one public-intelligence and one founder-presence request.

items.title: Make the elite footer a release-gated contract
items.why: The footer appears complete, but the canonical release gate must skip it because no declarative manifest exists.
items.premise: SESSION_PROTOCOL §11 says a missing manifest is SKIP and must be created before next release.
items.outcome: info-finding: navigation drift becomes a deterministic release failure.
items.recipe: Add a source-aligned manifest, validate canonically, and wire a local drift gate into build:check.
executionLog: Derived footer manifest from canonical header/footer graphs.
Propagated complete footer to 108 pages.
Local and canonical footer completeness gates pass.

items.title: Transport current Ark signature failure evidence without bypassing verification
items.why: Startup found 56 signature failures; accepting them or editing Studio Ops would violate the trust plane.
items.premise: Local dossier predates the current drain; Studio Ops owns producer normalization and repair.
items.outcome: info-finding: control plane receives reproducible evidence while invalid signatures remain rejected.
items.recipe: Ship a repair baton plus transient-degrade pattern-share through Ark and record receipts.
executionLog: Refreshed evidence at 56 rejected signatures without bypass.
Shipped repo-question 01JTMTLSA5D36C7417ABC7CFED and handoff 01JTMTLSH03842E0B6597F76DF to studio-ops.
